fields.title: 📖 Follow right guidance – even if few walk it
fields.body:
🖋️ **al-Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ** رحمه الله said:

***“Follow the paths of right guidance, and it will not harm you that few walk them. Beware of the paths of misguidance, and do not let the great number of those who perish deceive you.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
The truth is not measured by the number of its followers. Whoever follows the Sunnah remains steadfast, even if few walk with him; and whoever lets himself be deceived by the multitude can stray from the path of right guidance.
